svg.title: Figure 5 — Recorded cost and latency vs adjusted score
svg.desc: Recorded API cost per 1,000 records over current IDs (top) and median ms per record (bottom) vs adjusted score; log horizontal axes. Filled dot = complete coverage, open = incomplete (*). For cascades, cost is recorded API spend and latency is the per-record D1+reviewer sum; local passes carry no invoice. Medians for `jev`-adapter runs include a fixed client-side inter-request pause (0.3 s by default; 3.5 s for the Base Labs `:free` pair); `llm`-adapter runs have none. ≥ = partial or lower-bound cost; runs with no recorded API invoice are grouped in the right-hand category (a configuration count, not a record count; operating cost unmeasured). Per-configuration denominators are listed in the article's data table. 0 = majority. GT v5 · data cut v2.10.0
svg.text: recorded API cost per 1,000 records ($, log)
right lane = no recorded API invoice
